description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] to party, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Cor)] to the user, grants [XV Resonance +3% Boost] to all XV allies

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Cor)
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Samurai abilities

description.name: XV Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is XV

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II (Cor)]
